categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches `src/test/transaction_tests.cpp` with the `Tests` label, extending a test helper and unit test coverage for consensus validation.
categories.rationale: Extends unit test coverage for `Consensus::CheckTxInputs` to ensure transactions with cumulative input values exceeding `MAX_MONEY` are rejected. As noted in the description, mutant analysis revealed that changing `||` to `&&` in the `MoneyRange` check survived the test suite, making this a worthwhile addition to consensus test coverage.
